fullPassage: Today, the water crisis is political — which is to say, not inevitable or beyond our capacity to fix — and, therefore, functionally elective. That is one reason it is nevertheless distressing: an abundant resource made scarce through governmental neglect and indifference, bad infrastructure and contamination, and careless urbanization. There is no need for a water crisis, in other words, but we have one anyway, and aren't doing much to address it. Some cities lose more water to leaks than they deliver to homes: even in the United States, leaks and theft account for an estimated loss of 16 percent of freshwater; in Brazil, the estimate is 40 percent. The numerical comparison of available resources seems to exaggerate the real-world water shortage problem that we face. Seen in both cases, as everywhere, the selective scarcity clearly highlights have-and-have-not inequities, leaving 2.1 billion people without safe drinking water and 4.5 billion without proper sanitation worldwide.

questions.passage: Today, the water crisis is political — which is to say, not inevitable or __________ — and, therefore, functionally elective. That is one reason it is nevertheless distressing: an abundant resource made scarce through governmental neglect and indifference, bad infrastructure and contamination, and careless urbanization. There is no need for a water crisis, in other words, but we have one anyway, and aren't doing much to address it. Some cities lose more water to leaks than they deliver to homes: even in the United States, leaks and theft account for an estimated loss of 16 percent of freshwater; in Brazil, the estimate is 40 percent. The numerical comparison of available resources seems to exaggerate the real-world water shortage problem that we face. Seen in both cases, as everywhere, the selective scarcity clearly highlights have-and-have-not inequities, leaving 2.1 billion people without safe drinking water and 4.5 billion without proper sanitation worldwide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸 정답: beyond our capacity to fix (우리가 고칠 능력을 벗어난)
det.analysis:
✅ ② beyond our capacity to fix: 물 위기는 '피할 수 없거나 우리가 고칠 능력 밖의 일'이 아니라는 뜻 → 따라서 선택적(elective)이라는 논리
❌ ① within our daily control: 일상적 통제 안 — 문맥 흐름과 안 맞음
❌ ③ typical of poorer regions: 가난한 지역 특유 — 언급 없음
❌ ④ hidden from most experts: 전문가에게 숨겨진 — 언급 없음
det.tip: not inevitable or beyond our capacity to fix = 불가피하거나 고칠 수 없는 게 아니다
